subject: Urgent: Eval timer pause request while PO routes
messages: Subject: Urgent: Eval timer pause request while PO routes

Elena —

Quick note: I heard from Camila that your procurement team is still routing the PO for the sandbox purchase and the eval window on your account is set to expire tomorrow. We don’t want your engineers to lose momentum.

Can we put a 72-hour freeze on the trial timer while procurement finishes the PO? If you can confirm the PO is in flight and who in procurement we should expect to see the approval from, I’ll loop in Sales for formal sign-off.

I’ve attached a small usage summary so you can see how the trial is being consumed.

Thanks —
Hannah Schmitt
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.infer | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

Attachment: trial_usage_report_20260708.csv (csv)

-----Original Message-----
From: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@navitashealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.infer>
Date: Thu, 9 Jul 2026 16:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Urgent: Eval timer pause request while PO routes

Hannah —

Thanks for the ping. We are still waiting for AP to route the PO; finance asked for an extra vendor form which slowed things down. I’m copying procurement so they see this request. PO is titled “Navitas — Redwood sandbox” and the budget owner is Miguel Ortega.

Procurement contact: procurement@navitashealth.com (Maya Singh). Can you share what exact window you can hold and whether there are any limits to usage during the freeze?

Appreciate the quick help —
Elena
Sr. Product Manager, Navitas Health
elena.ramos@navitashealth.com

--
CC: Navitas Health Procurement <procurement@navitashealth.com>

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.infer>
To: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@navitashealth.com>, procurement@navitashealth.com
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.infer>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.infer>
Date: Thu, 9 Jul 2026 17:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: Eval timer pause request while PO routes

Hi Elena / Maya (procurement),

Thanks — we can do a short, no-cost pause to preserve the evaluation work. Proposed temporary terms (internal approval obtained):
- Pause length: 72 hours starting when you confirm the PAUSE request (we’ll set it on our side).
- Token/usage allowances: existing sandbox quota will be held; we won’t bill or consume additional paid units during the freeze.
- If procurement needs a slightly longer runway, we can consider a 7-day top-up pending Ben’s approval.

Attached is a one-page mutual action plan outlining next steps and the usage snapshot for your team to share with AP. Ben — can you confirm the 7-day top-up option would be possible if Navitas needs it? If so, we’ll require a sign-off from Miguel or an emailed PO referencing deal ID NH-2026-042 once the PO clears.

Elena — if you can reply with a one-line approval from procurement (Maya or Miguel) we’ll enact the 72-hour pause immediately.

Thanks —
Hannah
Attachment: proposed_mutual_action_plan_navitas.pdf (pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.infer>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.infer>, Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@navitashealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.infer>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.infer>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: Eval timer pause request while PO routes

All —

Confirmed from Sales leadership: we’ll approve the 72-hour freeze today and a conditional 7-day top-up if procurement confirms PO is in flight within that initial 72 hours. Conditions:
1) Procurement provides a one-line confirmation (Maya or Miguel) that the PO is routed and an ETA for expected approval.
2) Navitas agrees to re-open the trial once PO is received and provide PO number or DocuSign confirmation referencing NH-2026-042.

Hannah — please enact the 72-hour pause now. Laura — I’m looping you for visibility on this concession. Elena / Maya — if you reply with “Navitas confirms PO in flight (ETA 7 days)” we’ll mark the conditional top-up ready; otherwise the environment will unfreeze automatically at end of 72 hours.

Ben Carter
